rulings.item: Where the zone's one-time PR_GET_TSC query runs: (A, on branch) at the zone file load, so first_mktime 4736 -> 702 ns but first_localtime_r +2.9 us and _r-only programs pay one prctl; (B) at the first gate use, so first_mktime stays at ~6x
rulings.recommendation: A, then put tsc_probe on the hot-text list to shrink the load-path cost; amend D-23.6 with one sentence
